The closed set marks bus_rsp_o as set to constants only, but the RTL also assigns ctrl, FIFO, engine, and input-derived fields into bus_rsp_o.data at lines 143-156; the field-level entries were used.
The conceptual entries C1 and C2 list bus_req_i.data as an entry even though the actual writes use distinct bit slices of that record field.
